name: patterntest
description: This Website is supposed to be an easy and fun way to explore creative Coding aswell as Web-Developement and perhaps in the future even Web-Design. The idea is to do short or long sprints in creative coding, in order to explore and get better at p5js. The focus there is not to get a single, perfect project, but rather a lot of projects, where i explore old and new concepts and learn new things on the go. In this file i also have multiple kind of things going on, to further explore VS-Code and Git. Through that i hope to understand and learn more about web-developement and how i can build a file, maybe in the future even how to organize such a file in a clever and clean way. But thats for later, when there is more stuff going on :) The whole thing is set up with the min.js library and included the tailwind cli, so i can work offline and am not dependet on internet access.
